text:
mika_marketing: planning to announce Tue 10:00 PT. marketing needs final changelog link, docs URL, and a one-line perf stat for socials by EOD tomorrow. can eng/product commit? :calendar:

rajesh_eng: changelog PR in flight, should merge by EOD. docs drafted, pinging @elaine_product for sign-off.

elaine_product: i'll review docs this afternoon and add a "what this means" bullet + one-sentence support blurb. webinar: Wed 11am PT ok?

mika_marketing: Wed 11am PT preferred so we hit the immediate window. marketing will run email + social in first 24h.

toni_marketing: need a 280-char headline + a tweet-sized perf blurb. can eng give a single stat?

rajesh_eng: draft perf blurb: "~19% median text-gen latency improvement at 512 tokens; ~23% unit cost reduction using default batching + KV cache." use as teaser.

sam_release: rollout plan: prechecks 09:45 PT, canary start 09:50 PT, embargo lifts 10:05 PT after canary healthy, full ramp by 12:00 PT. ops-bot will run prechecks.

ops-bot: Precheck scheduled: start=2026-07-14T09:45:00Z, target=canary-pool-5, alert=#eng-oncall if fail.

rajesh_eng: changelog PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/pull/540. docs placeholder: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/2026-07-infer-announce (slug may change).

mika_marketing: marketing asks changelog to include: 1) "What this means for you" (2 bullets), 2) curl demo snippet, 3) inbound routing note for SDRs. can eng/product add those?

elaine_product: inbound routing note: tag leads "2026-07-infer" route to SDR queue "launch-inbound" with high priority for 48h. support blurb: "No API changes required for most users; update clients for batching improvements."

rajesh_eng: will add bullets + curl snippet: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"rw1-large","prompt":"Summarize"}'
```

toni_marketing: social draft incoming  will post for engineering accuracy check before scheduling.

mika_marketing: recap: EOD tomorrow = changelog merged + docs sign-off + perf stat locked; 09:45 PT prechecks, 09:50 PT canary, embargo lift 10:05 PT, webinar Wed 11am PT. confirm and i'll lock calendar. :white_check_mark:

rajesh_eng: confirmed. merging PR now.

elaine_product: confirmed  dropping slides + support one-liner into the drive by 5pm PT.

rajesh_eng: update: final perf pass adjusted median improvement to 17%. updating PR and docs now. prefixing "update:" per request.

toni_marketing: noted  will use 17% in the teaser. schedule still on. :rocket:
